notes.title: 1.1.2 update

notes.title: The Last Bloom 1.1 Update "No More Apple Pie" Available now!
notes.notes: [p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Localization[/b]: Now supports Thai and Turkish languages. You can switch languages in the settings menu. (More languages will be added in the future.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mystery Potion[/b]: Spawns randomly across the map. Curious about its effects? Give it a try! It might make your gameplay easier...or not.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balloon-Themed Check Point[/b]: Added a new symbol for Check Points for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hidden Helper[/b]: A new feature to make your gameplay easier, but you’ll need to unlock it yourself![/p][/*][*][p][b]Night-Only Event[/b]: A new event that occurs exclusively at night.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ending[/b]: Added one more unique ending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Secrets[/b]: Explore the game to uncover hidden surprises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Clues[/b]: Added hints to help you discover the game’s secrets more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Achievements[/b]: Added 2 new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FPS Limit Setting[/b]: Added an option to limit FPS in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pause Menu[/b]: You can now press the ESC key to pause the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the speed of monsters in the nighttime forest stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the speed of Wermut during both patrolling and chasing phases.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stamina regeneration rate, but when stamina is below 30%, the cooldown for regeneration will be longer.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of Jumpscares in the nighttime stages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI issues when switching controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI to make it more user-friendly and visually clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect dialogues in some instances.[/p][/*][/list]
